left.text: The blog relaunched in August 2026 with an open-source grant program: $15,000 across fifteen developers, each with platform credits, and a profile of each grantee to follow. The first profile is Fuma Nama, the author of Fumadocs, which the docs run on.

items.value: Fifty-four have been published. Each has four sections and a changelog headline.
Eight essays were removed. New essays argue one point with code and numbers.
Long-form interviews are built around the subject's own quotes.

right.caption: The post announcing the grant program, published on August 17, 2026, carries one of the two designed covers.
